description: Creates or updates the outgoing webhook subscriptions of the Webhooks feature. A subscription is matched by its ItemId; one without a matching ItemId is created. Every subscription needs a Name, a full https:// Url outside the site's own network, and at least one event.

items.description: An outgoing webhook subscription. Members that are omitted keep their stored values on an update.

ItemId.description: Optional unique identifier of the record. When it matches a stored record, that record is updated. Otherwise a new record is created under this identifier, so references to it from other entries and steps keep resolving.

Name.description: The name of the subscription shown in the admin.

Url.description: The full https:// address the events are posted to. Addresses on the site's own network are refused, except in development.

Events.description: The names of the events posted to the address, or '*' for every event. Modules register their own events, so the suggested names are not a closed list.

IsEnabled.description: Whether events are posted to the subscription.

Secret.description: Optional signing secret in clear text, encrypted when stored. A deployment plan never exports it. When omitted on a new subscription a random secret is generated; when omitted on an update the stored one is kept.

Subscriptions.description: The records to create, or to update when their ItemId matches a stored record.
